name: The Clockwork Parrot of Time's Square
description: A magnificent mechanical parrot with brass feathers and sapphire eyes perches on a weathered clock tower, its wings spread wide as it prepares to take flight into a swirling vortex of golden hour light.
prompt: An enormous mechanical parrot with intricate brass featherwork and glowing sapphire eyes perched atop an ancient stone clock tower, wings spread wide, gears and clockwork mechanisms visible beneath the metal plumage, golden hour sunlight streaming through a swirling time vortex in the sky behind it, dust particles of temporal energy floating in the air, highly detailed, fantasy steampunk art, cinematic lighting
caption: Time's messenger has arrived... ⏰🦜 Where would flying through time take you?
